This role also supports in-office events, manages supplies, and assists with logistics such as mailing packages and gifts to ensure seamless operations and positive in-office experience.

NTT DATA Services currently seeks a Legal Office Administrator to join our team in Irvine, CA

Key Responsibilities:
Legal Administration

  • Provides direct administrative support to the General Counsel.
  • Tracking the receipt and review of contracts, including follow-up, stakeholder communication, and detailed updates of contract tracking systems.
  • Strictly maintains all legal file organization including contracts, subrogation files, the legal compliance calendar and all legal compliance filing documentation.
  • Manage, negotiate, and settle subrogation liens under direction of the General Counsel.
  • Submit periodic filings with the U.S. Department of Labor, California Department of Insurance, Arizona Department of Insurance and other jurisdictions as needed.
  • Drafting letters, tracking follow-ups, and any other administrative support required by the General Counsel.
 
Meeting Scheduling/Coordination & Other Admin Functions
  • Provides high-level administrative support and assistance to the Executive staff and other assigned leadership staff as needed.
  • Performs clerical and administrative tasks including drafting letters, memos, reports, and other documents.
  • Scheduling office meetings between teams, managers, and departments including executive events, engagement events, in-office meetings, interviews and remote meetings.
  • Manages conference room set up, food ordering and prep, conference room clean up, minute taking and all other elements of in-office meetings including booking conference rooms.
  • Effectively reviews and considers all calendars for meeting scheduling to minimize congestion, ensure reasonable timing, and considers broader impacts.
  • Arrange travel and accommodation for executives when necessary.
  • Research and compares available travel and hotel accommodation to identify the best available option for each travel need, obtains approval and books travel within budget requirements as appropriate.
  • Performs office tasks including maintaining records, ordering supplies, mailing and scanning and basic bookkeeping.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.
Requirements:
  • Minimum 2 years in a professional administrative role.
  • High attention to detail including personal organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively summarize and engage in follow-ups.
  • Keen sense of urgency and an understanding of broader company impacts.
Preferred:
  • Legal Administrator experience
  • Healthcare Office Administration
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Project management certification.
